# Data cleaning
```{r}
method = 'umap'
# method = 'tsne'
# method = 'pacmap'

# data_type = "place_time_"
data_type = "place_"

file_path <- file.path(file.path(DATA_DIR, "4plot", paste0("doc_IRIS_", data_type, method, ".csv")))
df_plot_doc <- read.csv(file_path)
df_plot_doc
```

```{r}
df_plot_doc <- df_plot_doc %>%
  mutate(
    # --- DIPLOMA → short buckets ---
    DIPLOMA = na_if(str_squish(DIPLOMA), ""),
    DIPLOMA_SHORT = case_when(
      str_detect(DIPLOMA, "^5-year-and-above")       ~ "Master+ / Doctorate",
      str_detect(DIPLOMA, "^3–4-year higher")        ~ "Bachelor / Licence",
      str_detect(DIPLOMA, "^Upper secondary")        ~ "Upper secondary",
      str_detect(DIPLOMA, "^Lower secondary")        ~ "Lower secondary",
      str_detect(DIPLOMA, "^Vocational certificate") ~ "Vocational certificate",
      is.na(DIPLOMA)                                 ~ "Unknown / Not reported",
      TRUE                                           ~ DIPLOMA
    ),

    # --- PRO_CAT (1–8) → short labels ---
    PRO_CAT_SHORT = case_when(
      as.integer(PRO_CAT) == 1 ~ "Crafts/Business owner",
      as.integer(PRO_CAT) == 2 ~ "Executive/Prof.",
      as.integer(PRO_CAT) == 3 ~ "Intermediate",
      as.integer(PRO_CAT) == 4 ~ "Employee",
      as.integer(PRO_CAT) == 5 ~ "Worker",
      as.integer(PRO_CAT) == 6 ~ "Retired",
      as.integer(PRO_CAT) == 7 ~ "Student",
      as.integer(PRO_CAT) == 8 ~ "Unemployed/Inactive",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown / Not reported"
    ),

    # --- NB_CAR → categorical 0/1/2/3+ ---
    NB_CAR_CAT = case_when(
      is.na(NB_CAR)           ~ "Unknown / Not reported",
      NB_CAR == 0             ~ "0",
      NB_CAR == 1             ~ "1",
      NB_CAR == 2             ~ "2",
      NB_CAR >= 3             ~ "3+",
      TRUE                    ~ "Unknown / Not reported"
    ),

    # --- set preferred orderings (Unknown last) ---
    DIPLOMA_SHORT = fct_relevel(
      DIPLOMA_SHORT,
      c("Master+ / Doctorate",
        "Bachelor / Licence",
        "Upper secondary",
        "Lower secondary",
        "Vocational certificate",
        "Unknown / Not reported")
    ),
    PRO_CAT_SHORT = fct_relevel(
      PRO_CAT_SHORT,
      c("Executive/Prof.","Crafts/Business owner","Intermediate","Employee",
        "Worker","Student","Unemployed/Inactive","Retired","Unknown / Not reported")
    ),
    NB_CAR_CAT = fct_relevel(
      NB_CAR_CAT,
      c("0","1","2","3+","Unknown / Not reported")
    )
  )

# Quick checks (optional)
df_plot_doc %>% count(NB_CAR_CAT, sort = TRUE)
df_plot_doc %>% count(DIPLOMA_SHORT, sort = TRUE)
df_plot_doc %>% count(PRO_CAT_SHORT, sort = TRUE)

df_plot_doc
```

## All

```{r}
plot_embedding <- function(data, color_var, title, filename, custom_colors = NULL) {
  # Detect categories in the data
  categories <- levels(factor(data[[color_var]]))

  # If no custom colors, use paletteer but force Unknown → light grey
  if (is.null(custom_colors)) {
    if ("Unknown / Not reported" %in% categories) {
      # Build paletteer colors (enough for all categories except Unknown)
      base_colors <- paletteer::paletteer_d("rcartocolor::ArmyRose", n = length(categories))
      names(base_colors) <- categories

      # Override Unknown
      base_colors["Unknown / Not reported"] <- "#d9d9d9"

      scale_col <- scale_color_manual(
        values = base_colors,
        name   = title,
        labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 25)
      )
    } else {
      scale_col <- scale_colour_paletteer_d(
        "rcartocolor::ArmyRose",
        name   = title,
        labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 25)
      )
    }
  } else {
    # Use provided custom colors
    scale_col <- scale_color_manual(
      values = custom_colors,
      name   = title,
      labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 25)
    )
  }

  # Build the plot
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = .data[[color_var]])) +
    geom_point(size = 1.7, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_col +
    labs(title = paste("Location Time Embeddings colored by", title)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(size = 0.2),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(CODE_DIR, "fig", "doc", filename),
    plot = p,
    width = 9,
    height = 9,
    dpi = 600
  )
}

```

## Continuous
```{r}
# Define your color scale limits
min_z <- 15
max_z <- 70

# Create the plot
p <- ggplot(df_plot_doc, aes(x = x, y = y, color = AGE)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colors = armyrose_gradient,
    name = "AGE",
    limits = c(min_z, max_z),
    oob = scales::squish
  ) +
  labs(title = "t-SNE of Location Embeddings colored by AGE") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(size = 0.2),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p
```
